Pinned Bevy engine patches

bevy_render, bevy_pbr and bevy_solari originate from crates.io Bevy 0.20.0-rc.2,
upstream tag commit 343a0233d6788a49f224a3684c8995e246663df3.
The MIT and Apache-2.0 licenses remain alongside each copied production source.
Only manifests, licenses, upstream README files and production src trees are
retained. Dependencies are excluded from the single-package workspace.
The root [patch.crates-io] selects these sources; Cargo.lock pins the entire
Bevy dependency graph to the same RC. Original assets remain untouched.

Original crates.io package SHA256 checksums:
bevy_render 85dec5029f3bd8ca09f584f24df77d1bd096906062aa4377bc8af95d60f50136
bevy_pbr 69a4a0e861abccd2ff8c655415ab3981f401a83b930a4c5c7227a0b6297f709e
bevy_solari d3b48f81a2d3fa80a171fdb8b2655182f2b272dd17da05776b31b875810eee91

Local changes:
bevy_render: frame/workload-associated raw diagnostic records, bounded paired
query banks/readbacks, completed FIFO, earlier recording and coverage reporting.
bevy_pbr: stable per-shadow-view/face timing and invocation context; the native
vertex body is callable by extended materials through mesh_vertex, with the
original vertex entry point forwarding to it without changing its arithmetic;
incremental light extraction retains unchanged live shadow visibility tables
instead of retiring them as if the changed-only query were the live inventory.
bevy_solari: the RC's retained incremental scene, sparse uploads, cached bindings
and native TLAS build are adopted intact; native BLAS/TLAS diagnostic spans are
retained. No obsolete whole-scene binder or extraction gates are ported.

Upstream embedded binaries use Git LFS and remain byte-identical. Their working
files must be hydrated for native include_bytes! calls. Imported WESL trailing
ASCII spaces/tabs and excess EOF blanks may be normalized without changing tokens.
Package checksums identify upstream archives, not hashes of this patched tree.

Avian compatibility follows upstream PR 1070 at immutable revision
34c9b008d2f40638a953d9218db48d54f661365d, including its pinned Bevy-heavy,
transform-interpolation and matrix dependencies. It targets Bevy 0.20; root
exact RC constraints select rc.2 throughout. Existing f32 behavior is its default.
